why: The stirred-core fix (one burning model for a convective core, shared by the structure and the zone burn) to the end of central hydrogen, for the two stars of the resolution check (G 1e-17: s 1.5152 2.5 M_Ch and s 1.55 4.0 M_Ch), at the paper's resolution and at half the step. In the sandbox the fix took the main sequence's energy books from a median 1.4-2.3% off (worst 7-8%) to 0.07-0.18% (worst 0.8-1.3%) through Xc 0.3-0.4, and the stars live 1.7-2.8% longer at fixed Xc with L unchanged. On the old code the late main sequence still had single models up to 30% off (evolve4-24); this checks the fix there, and gives the life itself against the cached production tracks and evolve4-24's baselines. Tagged (tag=zf) so no production track is overwritten.
